headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (10)

summary: George Russell won the Australian Grand Prix from pole position, 3.0s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P20 to P6.
Liam Lawson had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 3 virtual safety cars.
There were 26 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
George Russell leads the championship by 7 points over Kimi Antonelli.
